description: Test suite for kubelet pod startup latency tracking, including metrics collection, pod state observation, image pull timing, and first network pod metrics.

methods.name: TestNoEvents
methods.description: Tests that no metrics are recorded when no pod events occur.

methods.name: TestPodsRunningBeforeKubeletStarted
methods.description: Tests behavior when a pod was already running before kubelet started.

methods.name: TestSinglePodOneImageDownloadRecorded
methods.description: Tests metrics collection for a single pod with one image download and startup.

methods.name: TestSinglePodMultipleDownloadsAndRestartsRecorded
methods.description: Tests metrics collection for a single pod with multiple image downloads and restarts.

methods.name: TestFirstNetworkPodMetrics
methods.description: Tests metrics for the first network pod startup duration.

methods.name: buildInitializingPod
methods.description: Helper to build a pod in initializing state.

methods.name: buildRunningPod
methods.description: Helper to build a pod in running state.

methods.name: buildPodWithStatus
methods.description: Helper to build a pod with specified container statuses.
